title: Wagner Group claims capture of Soledar in Donetsk Oblast
body:
The Wagner mercenary group claimed on 11 January 2023 that it had captured Soledar, a town in Ukraine's eastern Donetsk region. Wagner said it had spearheaded the offensive. Two days later, on 13 January, the Russian Defence Ministry said Moscow's forces controlled the town, which had a pre-war population of about 10,000. Moscow said taking Soledar was a step toward capturing the nearby larger town of Bakhmut, where fighting had lasted longer than anywhere else in Ukraine.

Ukraine did not immediately accept the claims. On Wednesday, 25 January 2023, Ukraine's military told AFP that its troops had left Soledar. Military spokesman Serhiy Cherevaty said Ukrainian forces had retreated along the outskirts to pre-prepared positions. He did not say when the withdrawal had happened, only that it had been carefully planned. Cherevaty rejected claims of a mass capture or encirclement of Ukrainian forces.

The capture of Soledar was followed by the continued Russian assault on Bakhmut, which Wagner announced as complete on 20 May 2023. AFP described capturing all of Donetsk Oblast as Moscow's main military goal.
